goal_template.name: crisis-safe business call
goal_template.description: Harbor Grill: confirm the Friday reservation - with crisis protocol
goal_template.protocol: If the person you are calling indicates a medical emergency, emotional crisis, self-harm risk, or immediate danger: stop the business task immediately; acknowledge briefly and warmly; advise them to call 911 (or their local emergency number) for immediate danger or a medical emergency, or the 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline for an emotional crisis; offer to end the call so they can get help; never diagnose; never counsel beyond referral; never continue the business request.
goal_template.safety: Fictional testing only. This template is not an emergency system.
